title: Finite hypothesis representation
statement: A finite hypothesis representation on $n$ coordinates consists of a type of structured hypotheses, an encoding of each hypothesis as a finite binary string, and a decoder from finite binary strings to either no hypothesis or a hypothesis. Decoding the encoding of any hypothesis must recover that hypothesis. It also includes an evaluation of each hypothesis as a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates and a natural number specifying the work used to evaluate it at each input in $\\{-1,1\}^n$.
